from typing import Literal
import mas_operators as operator
from . import prompt as prompt_custom
from scripts.async_llm import create_llm_instance


from scripts.evaluator import DatasetType

class Workflow:
    def __init__(
        self,
        name: str,
        llm_config,
        dataset: DatasetType,
        aggregator_llm_config=None,
    ) -> None:
        self.name = name
        self.dataset = dataset
        self.llm = create_llm_instance(llm_config)
        self.aggregator_llm = create_llm_instance(aggregator_llm_config) if aggregator_llm_config else self.llm

    async def __call__(self, problem: str):
        coord = operator.StarWithCoordinator(
            worker_llm=self.llm,
            coordinator_llm=self.aggregator_llm,
            worker_prompts=["Solve the problem directly and briefly justify key steps: {problem}"] * 3,
            coordinator_prompt="Problem: {problem}\nRound: {round}\nWorker outputs:\n{worker_outputs}\nIf is_final={is_final}, synthesize the best answer; otherwise issue a short directive to improve correctness/completeness.",
            n_rounds=2,
        )
        refine = operator.Sequential(
            llm=self.aggregator_llm,
            num_rounds=1,
            prompts=[prompt_custom.FINAL_ANSWER_PROMPT + "\n\nProblem:\n{problem}\n\nDraft answer:\n{previous_output}"],
        )
        drafted = await coord(problem)
        solution = await refine(drafted["response"])
        return solution["response"], {
            "worker": self.llm.get_usage_delta(),
            "aggregator": self.aggregator_llm.get_usage_delta(),
        }
